company_name: Saitama University, Science of Production and Environment Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The laboratory develops advanced microfabrication technologies for semiconductor substrate materials, which are crucial for manufacturing efficiency.
summary: Saitama University's Science of Production and Environment Laboratory specializes in precision and microfabrication technologies for semiconductor substrates and optical/electronic materials. Their innovations include laser slicing techniques and a clean buff polishing method for SiC substrates, aimed at enhancing manufacturing efficiency and reducing material loss.
capabilities: Laser slicing techniques for silicon carbide and diamond
Clean buff polishing method for high-speed mirror finish on SiC substrates
